title: 🎊$49 Knee Pain Exam and Relief Treatment (Save $300)
body_text:
👉 Hey Edmond/OKC area! Are you sick and tired of stiff, swollen, and achy knees slowing you down?

It’s time for a better option—one that doesn’t involve surgery, injections, or endless meds.

Hi, I’m Dr. Wes Hill from Hill Chiropractic, and we’re now offering a powerful, non-invasive solution that’s changing the game for knee pain relief:

Shockwave® Therapy – a cutting-edge technology that uses acoustic sound waves to target pain and activate your body’s natural healing process.

If you're struggling with:

✅ Knee pain when walking, squatting, or climbing stairs
✅ Swelling or stiffness that won’t go away
✅ Arthritis or meniscus issues
✅ Old injuries that keep flaring up
✅ Limited mobility or discomfort during your daily routine

We’ve got your back (and your knees) 🫵

How Shockwave® Therapy Works:

👉 Soundwave impulses go deep into the knee joint and surrounding tissues
👉 These waves stimulate the body’s natural healing at the cellular level
👉 Your brain responds by increasing stem cell activity where it's needed most
👉 Each session is customized by adjusting the energy and frequency for maximum relief

Benefits of Shockwave® Therapy:

💯 Reduces knee pain and inflammation
💯 Boosts blood flow to the joint
💯 Helps regenerate soft tissue
💯 Improves mobility and function
💯 100% non-invasive, no surgery, and no downtime

If you're tired of limping through life and want to get back to hiking, walking, or just moving without pain—now’s the time.

To get you ready for Spring & Summer, our comprehensive consultation, exam, and first Shockwave® Therapy session is just $49 (normally $349) 👀

Here’s what’s included:

✅ 1-on-1 Consultation & Orthopedic Knee Evaluation
✅ Digital X-rays (if needed)
✅ Detailed Doctor’s Report of Findings
✅ First Shockwave®  Therapy Session
✅ Customized Treatment Plan Built for You|

Click “Get Offer” to book your appointment now and take the first step toward pain-free knees. Let’s get you back to doing what you love 👇

title: Get Rid of Bacteria & Pet Odor from Your Washer
body_text:
If you've ever rewashed the same load twice because it still smelled like your pet, read this. 👇
The smell isn't on your clothes. It's inside your washing machine.

Pet hair and dander leave oils that build up in your washer and feed bacteria. Those bacteria form biofilm, a protective coating on your drum and rubber seal that survives every cycle. 

And rewashing just runs your clothes through the same contaminated water again.

The Washing Machine Cleaner Tablet dissolves biofilm inside the drum, seal, and pipes in one empty hot cycle. Once the biofilm is gone, pet odor stops transferring onto your laundry.

You simply drop one tablet every two weeks and let your machine do the rest:

✅ No scrubbing your gasket 
✅ No outdated vinegar tricks 
✅ No rewashing loads that still smell

We're so confident it works, you get 60 days to try it yourself. Don't notice a difference? You get every penny back.

Join over 100K pet parents who solved their laundry smell. Tap below and stop washing the same load twice.
